rounds.text: Rossell India Ltd exhibits severely weak capital efficiency, marked by a return on capital employed (ROCE) of just 6.4% [E6] and a return on equity (ROE) of only 4.5% [E7]. This poor operational performance is compounded by a long-term destruction of profitability, with compounded profit growth falling by -3% over 10 years [E11], -28% over 3 years [E12], and a sharp -40% over the trailing twelve months [E13].
